mapper.select: WITH target_record AS ( SELECT customer_id, contract_id, order_id FROM crm_on_payment WHERE id = #{paymentId} ), all_ids AS ( SELECT customer_id, contract_id, order_id FROM target_record ), customer_totals AS ( SELECT p.customer_id, SUM(p.real_money) AS customer_total_money FROM crm_on_payment p INNER JOIN all_ids a ON p.customer_id = a.customer_id WHERE process_pass = #{passFlag} GROUP BY p.customer_id ), contract_totals AS ( SELECT p.contract_id, SUM(p.real_money) AS contract_total_money FROM crm_on_payment p INNER JOIN all_ids a ON p.contract_id = a.contract_id WHERE process_pass = #{passFlag} GROUP BY p.contract_id ), order_totals AS ( SELECT p.order_id, SUM(p.real_money) AS order_total_money FROM crm_on_payment p INNER JOIN all_ids a ON p.order_id = a.order_id WHERE process_pass = #{passFlag} GROUP BY p.order_id ) SELECT COALESCE(c.customer_total_money, 0) AS customer_money, COALESCE(ct.contract_total_money, 0) AS contract_money, COALESCE(ot.order_total_money, 0) AS order_money FROM target_record t LEFT JOIN customer_totals c ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN contract_totals ct ON t.contract_id = ct.contract_id LEFT JOIN order_totals ot ON t.order_id = ot.order_id;
